name: Gaddiel
title: The Spy from the Tribe of Zebulun
summary: Gaddiel, son of Sodi, was the representative from the tribe of Zebulun among the twelve spies that Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He was one of the ten spies who brought back a negative report and discouraged the Israelites from entering the land. His lack of faith contributed to the entire people having to wander in the wilderness for forty years.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as a Scout
keyEvents.description: Gaddiel, son of Sodi, was chosen by Moses as the representative from the tribe of Zebulun to scout out the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Sent Out to Explore Canaan
keyEvents.description: Moses sent Gaddiel and the other eleven scouts from the wilderness of Paran to investigate the land of Canaan, its people, cities, and agriculture.

keyEvents.title: Forty Days of Scouting
keyEvents.description: Gaddiel and the other scouts explored the land of Canaan for forty days, from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob near Lebo-Hamath.

keyEvents.title: The Negative Report
keyEvents.description: Gaddiel was among the ten scouts who gave a negative report about the land, saying that the people there were too strong, which spread fear among the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: The People's Rebellion and God's Judgment
keyEvents.description: The negative report from Gaddiel and the other scouts led the people to rebel against Moses and Aaron, and God judged that generation to wander in the wilderness for forty years.

keyEvents.title: Death of the Scouts by Plague
keyEvents.description: The ten scouts who brought the negative report, including Gaddiel, died from a plague before the Lord as punishment for their faithlessness.
